name: journal_realized_scope_20261110
comment: ANCHOR: JOURNAL_REALIZED_SCOPE_20261110 — the overview realized total is priced sells only.
Sells with no cost basis stay out of that total. The journal returns priced_realized,
unpriced_count and unpriced_proceeds, and the header tile states that scope from those
fields. A failed unpriced read is None, not zero. Synthetic figures only.
